readout: FANA synthesis rate, normalized to the Tgo-D4K parent (fold)
assay_method: Polymerase kinetic profiling (PKPro). 20 nM polymerase, 1 uM 30-mer DNA template, 100 uM each NTP, 1x ThermoPol buffer, 2x LC Green Plus; denature 95 degC 3 min, extend 55 degC 30 min, fluorescence every 6 s; rate from a linear fit of nucleotides per polymerase vs time; mean of three independent replicates.
remark: No WT row: the readout is already normalized to the Tgo-D4K parent, which is 1.0 by definition. The reference sequence is the engineered Tgo-D4K parent, not native Tgo. Position 659 follows the source data, which carries Y and lists the variant as Y659E; the paper text instead calls it H659E. Q93A is listed twice with values differing by 7e-5, and the mean is used.

readout: Fitness score under 10 ug/mL ampicillin selection, as deposited; higher is more resistant
assay_method: Bulk competition of a whole-gene NNS saturation mutagenesis library of TEM-1 in Escherichia coli. The gene was split into ten non-overlapping subgroups, each mutagenised by NNS PCR, and the products mixed in equimolar ratios and ligated as a single library. Cells were grown to saturation in non-selective media, then diluted and grown in the presence of the antibiotic to perform the selection; two replicate selections were performed and variant abundance read out by 75-bp paired-end Illumina sequencing. Per-variant scores were taken from the authors' MaveDB deposit.
remark: Positions are sequential over the 286-residue preprotein, as the deposit numbers them, and not the Ambler numbering the beta-lactamase literature uses: Ambler equals sequential + 2 up to sequential 236, + 3 for 237-249 and + 4 for 250-287, corroborated by the STFK and SDN motifs and by the ambler column of the same group's deposit urn:mavedb:00000070. 133 of the deposit's 4,997 rows carry no score and are dropped. The deposit carries no wild-type row and does not state what the fitness score is relative to, so wt_readout is left empty and the zero point of normalized-score is the dataset mean; the article could not be retrieved (cell.com returns HTTP 403 to automated requests) and is not redistributed in papers/.
